The number of ways to choose 2 items out of 10 is given by the combination formula \( \binom{10}{2} \), which is calculated as follows:

\[
\binom{10}{2} = \frac{10!}{2!(10-2)!} = \frac{10!}{2!8!} = \frac{10 \times 9 \times 8!}{2 \times 1 \times 8!} = \frac{10 \times 9}{2 \times 1} = \frac{90}{2} = 45
\]
